_comment: COC.json (SNR 1, recorded bath noise, rates 10..1e6 Hz) in pA, for the self-calibrating network (train_selfcal_online.py), which needs pA levels and per-sample baseline / amplitude / sigma. Amplitude and sigma = 2000 counts = 6.1035 pA as in COC.json, varied by only +-1% (SNR 0.98..1.02); baseline +-1% of the amplitude. Mirrored: open above closed (COC.json has open 2000 counts below closed), and the grind window mirrored to match COC.json's 18000..24000 (closed - 1 sigma .. open - 1 sigma).

training._comment: closed level = baseline, open level = baseline + open_sign * amplitude (uniform draws)
